_comment: Reference `terraform show -json` for the apiable-logs-guardrail module — the operator-owned deploy-time guardrail (Org SCP + sanctioned bucket policy + single-source allow-list) that constrains the usage-firehose destination, captured from a CREDENTIALED plan in the apiable-logging account / Org management account. The deploying account here is a placeholder; CI regenerates this from a fresh credentialed plan. The committed fixture is the local oracle the deploy-time guardrail spec evaluates deny/allow against. The SCP Deny is principal-UNSCOPED with a closed operator carve-out (StringNotLike aws:PrincipalArn), so a hand-rolled delivery role is denied by default whatever it is named. Plan vars: sanctioned_logging_buckets=[apiable-logs-prod], sanctioned_delivery_role_arns=[arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/apiable-usagelogs-firehose, arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/apiable-usagetokens-firehose], operator_writer_arns=[arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/aws-service-role/backup.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForBackup], org_target_id=ou-root-loggingou, org_id=o-exampleorgid.

values.name: apiable-firehose-destination-guardrail
values.description: Deny any logging-family principal s3:Put* outside the sanctioned buckets, except the operator carve-out
